# vcp_vmware_networks (Data Source)

List VMware Cloud networks, optionally filtered by location.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List VMware networks, optionally filtered by location.
data "vcp_vmware_networks" "in_location" {
  location_id = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `location_id` (Number) Filter networks by location ID.

### Read-Only

- `networks` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))
